protocol.copyright: Copyright the Edel OS authors. GPL-3.0-or-later.

description.summary: the Edel shell's private link

protocol.description: What the compositor tells shell-ui and what shell-ui asks of it beyond the standard protocols (ADR-002, roadmap M5.3). Private: the two ship together in one image, so the interface grows within version 1 until the first public release. Not an extension API.

interface.name: edel_shell_v1

description.summary: the shell's link to the compositor

interface.description: Bound once by shell-ui. The compositor sends the shown workspace's policy when bound and whenever it changes, the launcher event when the launcher's key is pressed, the tray event when the tray's key is pressed (M5.9h), the volume and brightness keys (M5.9c), the keyboard's layouts and the one in use (M5.9f), which shell-ui asks to change with next_keyboard_layout, and the settings files' changes (M5.9h).

description.summary: stop listening

request.name: next_keyboard_layout

description.summary: go to the next keyboard layout

request.description: The next of the keyboard's layouts, as Super+Space does (M5.9f): the compositor answers with a keyboard event.

request.name: toggle_policy

description.summary: switch the shown workspace's policy

request.description: The other policy for the shown workspace only, as Super+Y does; the settings file is left as it is.

request.name: toggle_overview

description.summary: show the overview, or leave it

request.description: The overview, as Super+W shows it (M5.2j-b), or leaving it if it is open: a click on the switcher's lit workspace asks for it.

request.name: move_workspace

description.summary: move a workspace to another place

request.description: The workspace at place `from` moves to place `to`, both from 0, with its windows, its name and its policy, as a drag of its switcher button asks (M5.2p); the ones between shift by one. The settings file's names are the client's to write.

request.name: paste

description.summary: paste the selection into the focused window

request.description: The clipboard history (M7.13) set the item chosen as the selection over ext-data-control-v1 and closed its list: the compositor gives the keyboard back to the top window, if a layer holds it, and sends it Ctrl+V. Nothing while locked.

request.name: on_battery

description.summary: the machine runs on its battery or not

request.description: Whether the machine runs on its battery, as UPower tells shell-ui (M7.7c), sent when it changes: game mode's plugged-in rule follows it, so the compositor reads no battery of its own.

arg.name: on
arg.summary: 1 on the battery, 0 on the charger or with no battery

event.name: launcher

description.summary: show or hide the launcher

event.description: The launcher's key was pressed (Super, tapped alone, unless [shortcuts] says otherwise): shell-ui shows its launcher, or hides it if it is shown.

event.name: tray

description.summary: the tray's key was pressed

event.description: The tray's key was pressed (Super+Shift+B unless [shortcuts] says otherwise): shell-ui opens the grid of the apps behind the tray's arrow with the keyboard on its first app, or closes it (M5.9h).

event.name: settings

description.summary: the settings files changed

event.description: The settings files changed (M5.9h): shell-ui reads again what it reads from them while running, such as `panels.tray`. Sent at every change, whoever made it.

event.name: switcher

description.summary: show the window switcher

event.description: The switcher's keys (Alt+Tab, unless [shortcuts] says otherwise) are held: shell-ui shows the windows' titles, most recently used first, with the chosen one marked. Sent again at each step; at most ten titles, around the chosen one.

event.name: switcher_hide

description.summary: hide the window switcher

event.description: The switcher's keys were let go, or Escape pressed: the compositor has switched, or not, and shell-ui hides the list.

event.name: media_key

description.summary: a volume or brightness key was pressed

event.description: The keyboard's volume, mute or brightness key (M5.9c): shell-ui changes the level and shows it. The power button is one of them too (M7.8): shell-ui does what power.power_button says. The compositor keeps these keys from apps.

arg.name: key
arg.summary: volume_up, volume_down, mute, brightness_up, brightness_down or power

event.name: keyboard

description.summary: the keyboard's layouts and the one in use

event.description: The keyboard's layouts and the one in use (M5.9f): sent when bound, when region.keyboard changes and when the layout in use changes. shell-ui shows the indicator only with two or more.

arg.name: layouts
arg.summary: xkb's layout names, comma separated, such as de,us; empty for xkb's default

event.name: lock

description.summary: lock the screen

event.description: The lock key was pressed (Super+L unless [shortcuts] says otherwise), or the session is locked with no lock surface left, as when shell-ui was started again: shell-ui locks the screen with ext-session-lock-v1 (M5.10).

event.name: policy

description.summary: the shown workspace's policy

event.description: How the shown workspace places its windows.

event.name: styles

description.summary: the styles key was pressed

event.description: The tiling styles' key was pressed (Super+Shift+Y unless [shortcuts] says otherwise): shell-ui opens the layout button's menu of tiling styles with the keyboard on it, or closes it (M6.9).

event.name: lid

description.summary: the lid was closed or opened

event.description: A laptop's lid switch changed (M7.8), as libinput reports it: shell-ui does what power.lid_close says when it closes. Sent to every link, the greeter's too.

arg.name: closed
arg.summary: 1 when the lid closed, 0 when it opened

event.name: game_mode

description.summary: game mode went on or off

event.description: Game mode went on or off (M7.7), by Super+G or a change of power.game_mode: shell-ui shows it for a moment.

arg.name: on
arg.summary: 1 when game mode is on, 0 when it is off

event.name: playing

description.summary: a game is playing, or no longer

event.description: A game is playing (M7.7c): game mode is on and a fullscreen window is on top of a screen while nothing locks it and no overview is open. Sent when it changes, and when shell-ui binds while one plays: shell-ui stops its timers and draws nothing until it ends.

arg.name: on
arg.summary: 1 while a game plays, 0 when it ended

event.name: game

description.summary: a game plays on some screen, or on none

event.description: A game plays on at least one screen (M7.7b), as playing says for every screen: shell-ui asks for the performance power profile on the charger while one does, and gives the rules' profile back when it ends. Sent when it changes, and when shell-ui binds while one plays.

arg.name: on
arg.summary: 1 while a game plays on a screen, 0 when none does

event.name: clipboard

description.summary: the clipboard history's key was pressed

event.description: Super+V, unless [shortcuts] says otherwise (M7.13): shell-ui opens its clipboard history, or closes it if it is open.
